project.title: Exclusive fresh native workspace initialization
project.goal: Create protected new files with uninterrupted ownership and complete native canonical schemas without adopting existing data
project.scope: Fresh native creation only; bootstrap, attested reopen/adoption, transports and full platform remain required

component.host.description: Fresh namespace and native schema owning initialization

boundary.responsibility: Exclusive protected namespace before SQLite, original lease transfer and both-empty canonical schema construction with safe failure lifetime
boundary.rationale: Fresh creation supplies provenance instead of silently adopting existing ledgers
excludes: First-user bootstrap, attested existing-file reopen lineage, adoption/drain, endpoints/deployment, macOS namespace profile

scenario.normal.description: Complete versions30/36, new ledger UUID, caller company name, empty credentials/access/account plan; original lease retained

scenario.given: New absolute path below trusted private parent, strict broker profile and validated embedded schema artifacts
scenario.when: Create protected namespace, initialize canonical schema pair and explicitly close
scenario.then: Complete versions30/36, new ledger UUID, caller company name, empty credentials/access/account plan; original lease retained

scenario.busy.description: Exact connection and whole original namespace lease quarantined until process exit; private partial tree never reused

scenario.given: Actual fresh constructor has an outstanding control statement and transaction
scenario.when: Constructor returns an error and Drop encounters close BUSY
scenario.then: Exact connection and whole original namespace lease quarantined until process exit; private partial tree never reused

scenario.partial.description: Control is complete, company empty, no initialized owner/report returned; private partial namespace remains

scenario.given: Both databases empty but independent company writer competes
scenario.when: Control initialization commits before company BEGIN IMMEDIATE is refused
scenario.then: Control is complete, company empty, no initialized owner/report returned; private partial namespace remains

scenario.retired.description: Existing contents untouched; invalid or unsafe input creates no new directory

scenario.given: Existing path, bad input or unsafe process/parent/default ACL
scenario.then: Existing contents untouched; invalid or unsafe input creates no new directory

scenario.privacy.description: Complete private resource set follows confirmed-close/BUSY retention; no raw connection or partial owner escapes

scenario.given: Fresh owning constructor has opened real SQLite handles
scenario.when: Any later initialization or physical validation fails
scenario.then: Complete private resource set follows confirmed-close/BUSY retention; no raw connection or partial owner escapes

scenario.concurrent.description: Exactly one creator wins; original lease excludes other owners through schema initialization

scenario.given: Two strict broker processes target the same absent root
scenario.when: Both attempt exclusive creation while lock contenders inspect returned owner
scenario.then: Exactly one creator wins; original lease excludes other owners through schema initialization

scenario.outcome.description: Both preflight before persistent writes, preserve existing data/identity and refuse rather than repair or resume

scenario.given: Either database already has schema/data/temp objects/attachments/metadata or active transaction
scenario.when: Attempt schema initialization or repeat creation
scenario.then: Both preflight before persistent writes, preserve existing data/identity and refuse rather than repair or resume

action.fresh_workspace.description: Exclusively create a protected fresh native workspace

output.description: Opaque Owner plus schema versions/fingerprints and new ledger UUID; no first-user/adoption authority

errors.refused: Unsafe/unsupported process or namespace, existing root, nonempty/invalid database, SQL/I/O failure or unresolved close

preconditions: Strict dedicated-UID profile and trusted/enrolled broker code
Absent destination below validated trusted parent; no earlier/inherited/passed client descriptors
Host owns both fresh actual connections and full physical lifetime before schema construction
postconditions: Existing destination is never reused, altered, repaired or recursively deleted
Original root lease held before SQLite and through returned owner or unresolved-close quarantine
Both schemas validated before report; no credential, access or account plan seeded; independent commits may leave a private partial failure
external_effects: Create new0700 namespace and0600 files, fsync files/directories/parent and hold directory flock
Commit canonical control/company schema/history and company profile; generate immutable ledger UUID
Retain a private partial tree on failure; quarantine unresolved handles/lease until process exit

boundaries.rationale: Exclusive creation, all-input/ancestor checks and empty-only data refusal

concurrency.rationale: Exclusive mkdir winner and uninterrupted original lease through schema creation

authorization.rationale: No first-user/access authority seeded; strict broker and offline provisioning remain required

idempotency.rationale: Creation is deliberately non-idempotent; repeat/partial trees refused without adoption

atomicity.rationale: Each DB schema is transactional but two commits are independent; failed constructor never returns owner

action.fresh_workspace.behavior: Validate process/input/parent before exclusive mkdir; retain original lease before file creation, close creation descriptors before SQLite open, validate both empty connections, commit each complete canonical schema transaction, return owned native pair only after physical revalidation
